g.text: P90/P10 Bader-error spread in 0.5-decade Hartree-error bins; 55.4% of rows lie in bins >= 10x
D | Similar Hartree fidelity does not imply similar Bader fidelity

Hartree statistics use only reproduction-gate-passing rows. The 73 SZ3 stream-size mismatches are excluded by the frozen gate. Strict monotonicity is weaker for slabs; the slab contrast is supported by R2, local elasticity, and jump magnitude rather than strict monotonicity alone.
global linear: electron count -> smooth nonlocal: Hartree potential -> topology-dependent: Bader charge
